# fct_via_agent_actions

`data-warehouse-359101.analytics.fct_via_agent_actions` · dbt area: `portal`

Fact table for Via agent actions. Each row is a single agent action (a 'tool-return' message) taken during a Via conversation, carrying the tool used, cost and the owning advisor. Deduped to show only one action per tool type per agent message. Sourced from the Portal database.

| Column | Description |
|---|---|
| `message_id` | Primary Key. Unique ID for each agent-action (tool-return) message. >> SOURCE - Portal data_tests: - unique - not_null |
| `agent_action_sequence` | The ordering of this agent action within deduped actions taken from the conversation. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `conversation_id` | Foreign Key. The Via conversation this action belongs to. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `session_id` | Foreign Key. The Via session this action belongs to. New sessions start after a 30+ minute gap in conversation activity. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `conversation_sequence` | The ordering of this agent action within all conversation messages. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `user_message_id` | Foreign Key. The agent message this agent action comes from. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `advisor_id` | The advisor ID associated with the conversation. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `advisor_uuid` | The advisor UUID associated with the conversation. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `tool_name` | The name of the tool invoked (e.g. supplier_search, web_search, etc.) extracted from the message content payload. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `cost_usd` | The cost of this individual action message in USD. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `created_at` | Timestamp when the action message was created. >> SOURCE - Portal |
